note: One entry per top-level skill directory under .claude/skills/ (find .claude/skills -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name SKILL.md). `source` is "owned" when no external-origin signal exists in the tree, otherwise the most specific origin the repo actually records — a GitHub owner/repo where one is written down, otherwise the literal author/origin label from the skill's own frontmatter or README. `ref` and `path` are absent everywhere because no upstream commit, tag or subdirectory is recorded anywhere in this repo; they are omitted rather than invented, so no entry here can be re-resolved by fetch yet. `computedHash` is carried forward from the previous lock and is an integrity hash of the local copy only. `references[]` pins vendored subtrees inside an owned router skill. No content hashes: the 0.1-era hashing algorithm was never recorded, so a hash cannot be recomputed or checked; provenance is source + evidence.
